title: Code list
description: A list of codes shared by several variables, or published separately by the publisher. One per line in metadata/code_lists.jsonl. Optional (STANDARD.md §4.5).

id.description: Unique; names the list's version, e.g. census-occ-2010, iucr-20261119.

codes.description: The publisher's codes, in its order; each a value as in a variable record (STANDARD.md §4.2).

columns.description: The publisher's other columns, carried in each code's attributes: name -> description.
